In early Christian legends, Innis was believed to be the name of a sacred island where ancient monks and saints lived in solitude and prayer. The name Innis carries the meaning “Island, hollow place” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
